acceptance: Proposed successor to fixtures-and-slices.json (v1, accepted via DEC-0006). Acceptance vehicle: DEC-0007; on acceptance SUP-0002 records the supersession and this file becomes the governing fixture taxonomy. Until then v1 governs.
derived_from: v1 charter artifact; owner-supplied fixture authoring packet (SRC-0003); pattern program (fixtures/sources/packet/PATTERN_DRIVEN_EXPANSION.md)

fixture_taxonomy.enumeration_owner: packages/contracts/fixtures/registry.json (machine-readable inventory; this charter owns the taxonomy and gate meaning, the registry owns the per-fixture records)
fixture_taxonomy.f1_exit_requirement: Four complete production fixtures (FIX-STILLHOUSE, FIX-EDITORIAL, FIX-BKR, FIX-COMMERCE) plus eight compact schema probes contribute to GATE-0003. Model broadly in F1 using compact schema probes; execute progressively using full production fixtures.
fixture_taxonomy.post_f1_rule: Nineteen registered post-F1 production fixtures are committed validation obligations, dependency-phased on the capabilities they exercise; their later-phase execution never blocks GATE-0003.
fixture_taxonomy.metamorphic_rule: Transformation-test families are registered now and activate by phase: MET-F1 in F1, MET-F3 at F3, MET-B3 at B3, MET-B4 at B4 and later.
fixture_taxonomy.canon_boundary: Fixtures are test material, never automatically commercializable inventory; fixture-only canon promotes to production property canon only through a separate explicit owner decision.
fixture_taxonomy.generic_primitive_rule: Add a new generic primitive only when at least two materially different fixtures require the same semantics and existing concepts (facts, assertions, entities, knowledge, timeline, state, narrative units, branches, sources, rights, derivations, reviews, packages) cannot represent the need coherently.

golden_fixtures: superseded_enumeration: see fixtures/registry.json classes f1_production_fixtures and post_f1_production_fixtures

vertical_slices.name: Portable project round trip
vertical_slices.proof: create, accept, export, remove local copy, re-import; reproduce versions, hashes, lineage, rights, receipts

vertical_slices.name: Serialized still-media property
vertical_slices.proof: three episodes with recurring identity/style/object continuity and focused panel regeneration

vertical_slices.name: Commerce campaign
vertical_slices.proof: full brief-to-publication flow including rejection, focused revision, source drift, observations

vertical_slices.name: BeKindRewind runtime slice
vertical_slices.proof: locations, characters, objects, mission dependencies, runtime package, promotional derivatives

vertical_slices.name: Cross-channel derivation
vertical_slices.proof: carousel, Story/Reel plan, and web/email package from one accepted episode and one lineage tree

vertical_slices.name: Governed learning loop
vertical_slices.proof: scoped observations become a reviewable variation proposal without changing canon

vertical_slices.name: Paying external team
vertical_slices.proof: a new team onboards, pays, produces, approves, exports, returns, and can export/delete its data

stop_conditions.stop_or_narrow_when: genre-specific forks are required before media generation
value is predominantly generic generation rather than continuity and workflow savings
the shared model becomes a lowest-common-denominator abstraction; split higher-level products and share only proven low-level packages
campaigns are not published, repeated, easier to approve, or commercially useful
still workflows unreliable or written video quality/cost gates unmet
export-first remains sufficient; API risk unjustified
repeat paid non-commerce demand does not meet the S1 gates
no measured scale, security, failure-isolation, or team-boundary evidence (see ADR-0016)

fixture_rules: Fixtures are rights-safe test material, never commercializable inventory.
Source content is owner-supplied (PLAN-0007) with ownership, sensitivity, and permitted use recorded.
